params.name: QUERY
params.value:
"
MERGE " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + " T
USING (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SystemId ORDER BY SystemModifiedAt DESC) AS rn
    FROM " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + "Delta
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) D
ON T.SystemId = D.SystemId

WHEN MATCHED AND (
  T.SystemModifiedAt IS NULL OR D.SystemModifiedAt > T.SystemModifiedAt
) THEN
UPDATE SET
  Amount = D.Amount,
  AmountIncludingVAT = D.AmountIncludingVAT,
  Bill_to_Address = D.Bill_to_Address,
  BillToAddress2 = D.BillToAddress2,
  BillToCity = D.BillToCity,
  BilltoContactNumber = D.BilltoContactNumber,
  BillToCountryRegiondCode = D.BillToCountryRegiondCode,

  CompletelyShipped = D.CompletelyShipped,

  SellToPhoneNumber = D.SellToPhoneNumber,
  SellToPostCode = D.SellToPostCode,
  ShipmentDate = D.ShipmentDate,
  ShippingAgentCode = D.ShippingAgentCode,
  ShipToAddress = D.ShipToAddress,
  ShipToAddress2 = D.ShipToAddress2,
  ShipToCity = D.ShipToCity,
  ShipToCountryRegionCode = D.ShipToCountryRegionCode,
  ShipToCounty = D.ShipToCounty,
  ShipToName = D.ShipToName,
  ShipToName2 = D.ShipToName2,
  ShipToPhoneNumber = D.ShipToPhoneNumber,
  ShipToPostCode = D.ShipToPostCode,
  SystemCreatedAt = D.SystemCreatedAt,
  SystemCreatedBy = D.SystemCreatedBy,
  SystemModifiedAt = D.SystemModifiedAt,
  SystemModifiedBy = D.SystemModifiedBy,
  VATReportingDate = D.VATReportingDate,
  YourReference = D.YourReference

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (
  SystemId,
  Amount,
  AmountIncludingVAT,
  Bill_to_Address,
  BillToAddress2,
  BillToCity,
  BilltoContactNumber,
  BillToCountryRegiondCode,
  BilltoCounty,
  BillToName,
  BillToName2,
  BillToPostCode,
  CompletelyShipped,
  CurrencyCode,
  CurrencyFactor,
  DocumentDate,

  SystemCreatedAt,

  VATReportingDate,
  YourReference
)
